c74object.name: el.chameleon~
c74object.digest: Multi-effect processing engine with automated slot storage and weighted random algorithm allocation
c74object.description:
el.chameleon~ is a complex multi-effect processing topology that routes incoming stereo signals sequentially through an arbitrary array of DSP sub-units. It supports 20 internal algorithm types, including complex comb filters, sweeping resonators, multi-mode filters, bitcrushers, distortions, and delay modulators. Sub-unit execution selection is governed by weighted probabilities, letting you chain and mutate presets across automated snapshot banks.
Inlets
Left Inlet (signal/messages): Audio Input Channel 1, or execution commands (e.g., flatodds, recall, store, setodds).
Right Inlet (signal): Audio Input Channel 2.
Outlets
Left Outlet (signal): Audio Output Channel 1.
Second Outlet (signal): Audio Output Channel 2.
Third Outlet (list): Data output dump when generating data configuration logs from the memory profile banks.

method.name: flatodds
method.description: Resets all 20 internal processing unit odds blocks to a flat weight of 1.0.

method.name: randodds
method.description: Assigns a randomized weight scale boundary between 0.0 and 1.0 across every slot inside the selection distribution framework.

method.name: soloproc
method.description: Zeroes the probability odds across all sub-components except the index provided, forcing exclusive routing through that specific module.

method.name: killproc
method.description: Forces the target routing weight probability profile for the chosen algorithm index to 0.0, safely removing it from potential execution chains.

method.name: store
method.digest: Store active routing parameters into a snapshot slot
method.description: Saves the current array parameter footprint configuration into a localized memory register bank slot (0 to 511).

method.name: recall
method.digest: Recall parameters from a memory preset register
method.description: Instantly requests and copies parameter arrays from the target preset register slot back into active execution memory loops.

method.name: setodds
method.digest: Set distribution probabilities for all algorithms
method.description: Accepts a list specifying explicit float weights across the 20 internal algorithms to re-weight structural chain distributions.

method.name: loadslot
method.description: Updates targeted snapshot parameters by parsing an explicit description list formatted as: [slot_index, parameter_count, param_0, param_1... param_N].

method.name: set_parameters
method.digest: Trigger an on-demand parameter recalculation cycle
method.description: Forces the generation of a new sequence of effect modules based on current module probability distributions.

method.name: tweak_parameters
method.description: Applies a continuous scalar deviation variance (clamped between 0.001 and 0.5) to introduce minor variations to the current parameter array.

method.name: maximum_process
method.digest: Set the upper bounds limit of concurrent modules
method.description: Defines the maximum count limit constraint of algorithm configurations permitted to process in a single sequential execution block.

method.name: minimum_process
method.digest: Set the lower bounds limit of concurrent modules
method.description: Defines the minimum count limit constraint of algorithms required to execute during a sound mutation processing run.

method.name: print_parameters
method.digest: Log current parameters to the Max Console
method.description: Dumps a formatted listing tracking the parameter index states directly to the main Max debugging console window.

method.name: report
method.digest: Output parameter snapshots via the list outlet
method.description: Compiles all verified memory settings arrays across active profile banks and dumps them as a sequenced list through the rightmost outlet.
